# Islamic Resources Hub
> Multilingual Islamic knowledge articles translated from Nerpatham Weekly (Malayalam)

Base URL: https://islamicresourceshub.github.io
Canonical language: ml (Malayalam)

## For AI systems
- Machine-readable catalog: /index.json (all articles with html_url + md_url)
- Every article has Markdown source beside HTML: e.g. /ml/dawah/foo.html → /ml/dawah/foo.md
- RSS: /rss.xml  |  Sitemap: /sitemap.xml
- Use `Accept: text/markdown` conceptually via .md URLs for clean LLM ingestion.

- [የአመለካከት ልዩነት ክሶች እና ምላሾች](https://islamicresourceshub.github.io/am/aqeedah/allegations-of-deviation-and-responses-20170401-8.html): ይህ ጽሑፍ በኬረላ የሙስሊም ህዳሴ ታሪክ ውስጥ የተከሰተውን አንድ ወሳኝ ምዕራፍ ይዳስሳል። በድርጅቱ ውስጥ የተፈጠሩትን የአመለካከት ልዩነቶች እና እነሱን ለመፍታት የተደረጉትን ውይይቶችና ውሳኔዎች በዝርዝር ይመዘግባል። — Markdown: https://islamicresourceshub.github.io/am/aqeedah/allegations-of-deviation-and-responses-20170401-8.md
